activity.notes: Comcomly (also Concomly) was a Lower Chinook headman and principal chief at the mouth of the Columbia River. Contemporary and regional historical sources show him as a subordinate chief in 1795–1796 and as the principal Chinook chief by the Fort Astoria era; ATLAS therefore uses c.1811–1830 as a conservative leadership interval rather than inventing an accession date. He died in the 1830 epidemic.

sources.title: Concomly (1765?-1830?) — The Oregon Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The Oregon Encyclopedia identifies Concomly as the Baker's Bay Chinook headman, documents his rise in influence by the Fort Astoria era, and records his death in 1830.

sources.title: Comcomly (1760s?-1830) — HistoryLink
sources.citation_text: HistoryLink traces Comcomly from a sub-chief recorded in 1795 to the principal chief of the Chinook nation in the Fort Astoria period and records his death in 1830.
